title: Church music, in the city and at Magnolia
summary: Churches he played with, and the unaccompanied hymns, anthems and jubilee singing at the plantation church.

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular

blocks.x: Which church was that that had music and had a band?
In the choir, yeah. Which church was that? Plenty of them have.
I know some of them do here.
And then, oh, yeah. And there's a First Remission Baptist Church. I played with them.
Well, very Miss Matthews played in that church, didn't he?

Yeah, he played in the church. He owned a drum. I don't know if they had any other instruments or not. But the time won't have been good in there. I'd have them mute, you know, and sighting numbers when they'd play them, like an overture, as they call them, anthem, you know. And they'd play that or sighting part in any sounds nice.
Can you tell us anything about the music in the churches down at Magnolia? Did they have a church down there that you belonged to?
I wasn't joined up with the church at the time.
Did you hear any music down there in the churches ever from outside or any place there? Spirituals or?
Instrumental to me? Well, any kind.
Even singing. Spirituals or gospel songs. What kind of music did they have?
Oh, they didn't even have a piano. You know how to concert tracer, but they didn't even have a piano. No organ or piano? No organ or piano. No organ.
What kind of, what was the singing like? Would they sing hymns?

They sing with, like anthem like. Slower numbers? Then they would sing jubilee. They'd mix them in, you see. Just like to do that. They, I think they call them an anthem. They'd word it out. Then they'd sing them strings. Then they'd word it out again and sing some more, you know. I don't know how to call that.
What were the jubilee songs like? Were they fast, fast, beat?

Oh yeah. Sometime when they, when they, sometime they would start to clap their hands on the jubilee. Sometimes the sisters would shout, you know, just like a person would dance. Yeah. Yeah. That would, that would be, that would, that would be in, after preaching and things like that, they would get on these things. Then they had what they call a social. Sometime we would give a social, you know, and selling different things. Then they would sing hymn because they were on the churches and, and they'd be shouting or I don't know what they call it. It wasn't dancing, but soon they're dancing and I don't know what it is.
